renderings.value: It's the class bell. The pupils that had been around the school gate quickened their steps as one.
The teacher asked me if I was ready, adding that everybody was waiting for me at the school gate.
The gates of the school open at eight.
I bumped into Miru at the school gates, just as she was arriving from the girls' dormitory.
The student council was putting up decorations for the school festival by the school gate.
